sources.prompt:
Japanese anime-style chibi mobile-game environment art, like the tile set of a cosy slice-of-life anime puzzle game. Drawn by hand by a professional 2D anime game background artist: flat cel colours with one crisp hard-edged shadow tone, thick dark-brown outline (#4A2A1A) with slight natural line-weight variation (thicker on outer silhouettes, thinner on inner details), one small flat white highlight per shiny surface, chunky rounded chibi shapes (buildings, trees, rocks and props squashed and rounded like cute toys), limited warm Japanese palette, light from the top-left. Few, deliberate details, every shape clearly readable at 64 pixels. Avoid the typical AI-art look: no airbrushed or soft gradient shading, no plastic or 3D-render sheen, no photographic texture, no texture noise, no random extra sparkles or particles, no melted or merged details, no blurry edges. No characters or people unless asked, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark. Outline weight matches a cartoon salmon-nigiri game icon.

Setting: the Osaka Street Stall region of the map, an Osaka food street at dusk: red-and-cream stall awnings, glowing signboards shaped like food (no letters), takoyaki stands and a canal. Region colours: banner #F08A3C to #C25A16, land #E6C47A.

Tile sheet: 2x2 grid of 4 equal 512x512 cells, one item per cell, no borders, no grid lines, no gutters, no labels, no numbers. Straight top-down view, flat, no perspective. Every item at the same scale with the same outline weight. Ground tiles fill their cell edge to edge, opaque, with no outline or border round the cell; the left edge matches the right edge and the top edge matches the bottom edge so each repeats seamlessly.

Land:
f1 (top-left) land_a: warm sandy earth with a few paving-stone outlines in #E6C47A.
f2 (top-right) land_b: the same ground about 12% lighter, details in other places, so it alternates with land_a.
f3 (bottom-left) land_c: land_a with a dropped paper lantern-shaped leaf and two pebbles.
f4 (bottom-right) land_d: land_b with a dropped paper lantern-shaped leaf and two pebbles.
Output one square 1024x1024 fully opaque PNG sheet with four exact equal logical quadrants. Flat uniform sandy earth color #E6C47A in land_a and land_c, and approximately 12% lighter sandy earth in land_b and land_d. Only a few subtle rounded paving-stone outlines inside each tile. Keep all markings, leaves and pebbles at least 8% away from the quadrant edges; the border areas stay plain earth color for seamless repetition. The rare variants each contain exactly one fallen leaf with a gently ribbed paper-lantern-like silhouette and two little pebbles; this is a leaf, not an actual illuminated paper lantern. No scenery, stalls, trees, grass or buildings. No gradients, edge shadows, vignette, cell borders, drawn separators or gutters.

edits.prompt: Edit this Osaka portrait puzzle background. Change only the lower layout: the current lower awnings, lanterns, canal railing, stall counters and canal start too high. Redraw this entire lower scene inside the bottom 20% of the canvas only, y=1230 through y=1535. The uppermost pixel of any lower awning, railing, lantern or other lower scenic object must be at y=1230 or below. Extend the existing quiet, plain peach background all the way down to y=1229 across the FULL canvas width. In particular, x=0..1023 and y=384..1229 must contain only the uninterrupted pale peach field, no objects, lines or water. Keep a readable small red-and-cream stall counter at each lower corner and a compact canal strip along the bottom; simplify these lower shapes to fit.
